statement_en: Let $q$ be a positive integer. Let $a_1>0$, and suppose the sequence satisfies the difference equation $$\Delta a_n= \frac{f(n)}{S_n^q}$$ where $f(n)>0$, $f(n)\sim \alpha n^{2\beta}$, and $\beta>\frac{q-1}{2}$. Then $$\lim_{n\to \infty} \frac{a_n}{n^{\gamma}} =\left(\frac{\alpha(\gamma+1)^q}{\gamma}\right)^{\frac{1}{q+1}}$$ where $\gamma=\frac{2\beta-q+1}{q+1}$.
